ValidationRule.description: If IsAvailable, the end of the preferred time window must be > Start and <= End
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( sked__Is_Available__c , NOT( ISBLANK( sked__Preferred_End__c ) ) , OR( sked__Preferred_End__c <= sked__Start__c , sked__Preferred_End__c > sked__End__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If IsAvailable, the end of the preferred time window must be > Start and <= End
